correctness.rationale: The orbit-barycenter homeomorphism, cyclic Cayley gcd connectivity equivalence, prime-indexed simplex cover, exact nerve identification and Hultman 2-density hypotheses have been reconstructed for every finite nonempty complex. Five finite models independently passed BFS, prime-cover, nerve and mod-two boundary checks. No finite test is used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an explicit universal realization of arbitrary finite homotopy types, including torsion, in full cyclic geometric fixed loci while all ambient complexes are wedge-of-equal-dimensional-spheres. This nontrivial contrast between nonequivariant and fixed-space topology is structural and not a table recomputation.
